notes.title: Wild Terrain has 10,000 Wishlists! Thank You!
notes.content: [p]Wild Terrain has just hit [u][b]10,000+[/b][/u] wishlists! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who's wishlisted or shared the game so far. It's been truly inspiring to see all the excitement for our game across social media, especially among animal fans![/p][p][/p][p]Your support means so much to our small team, and we can't wait to share more updates with you very soon. You can also follow us on TikTok, Reddit and X to see more videos and screenshots.[/p][p]- Tarrum @ TigerDog Games[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321041/de095bd39a788d07d9bbb9e4e11eb3ffb30c88ea.jpg"][/img][/p]
